title: Non-executive director
summary: Non-executive director Iván Markman resigned from the board on 6 November 2026, 15 months after joining (Companies House). Co-founders Jonathan Bean and Robert Forrest are now the only directors.
Now trades as MatNex: materialsnexus.com/careers redirects to matnex.ai/careers, which says it hires selectively and lists no vacancies.

title: Office of the CEO; Chief Government Affairs Officer
summary: Two of the 33 leaders on the 24 September team page are no longer listed: Jack Milwid (Office of the CEO) and Chris O'Donnell (Chief Government Affairs Officer). Chris Fussell moved from President, Operations to Vice Chair, and Jon Hennek from Chief Revenue & Product Officer to Chief Product Officer.

title: Leadership team, Strategy and Operations
summary: Steve Edkins (Strategy and Operations), on the leadership page in October 2026, is no longer listed. The other seven leaders remain, and the job board is down to a general-application posting.

Atinary's own job ads now describe it as "Headquartered in Menlo Park, California, with operations in Boston and Lausanne". The roles themselves are in Epalinges, near Lausanne. The AI for Chemistry Scientist ad says the company has "recently opened our own autonomous self-driving lab".

The redesigned site sells Mattiq as a source of experimental materials data for AI: "Mattiq generates the ground truth that turns AI prediction into reality". It cites 250M material instances and 100K compositions per Megalibrary chip. It no longer leads with electrocatalysts, and it has no careers page.

The redesigned site leads with AI-driven drug formulation for pharma partners and cites a multi-year licensing agreement with Quotient Sciences. It has no careers page, and LinkedIn lists no openings.
Its careers page (company-pages/careers, live in May 2026) now returns 404, and LinkedIn's job search finds no Polymerize postings.

Posted a Senior Solutions Scientist role on LinkedIn for its Cambridge, MA office (25 November, 59 applicants by 28 November). The office opened in 2024-09. This is the first US posting in the survey's record for Matlantis; its Japanese hiring runs through BizReach and its own careers page.
verified_by: LinkedIn public job search, logged out, 2026-11-28

summary: A Form D under its legal name, Mitra Future Technologies, Inc., records $15.6M sold of a $50.0M equity offering (first sale 23 May 2025, signed 6 Jun 2025). This settles the conflicting reports of a 2025 Series B extension. It also names two directors who are not on the team page, Jiang-Ling Du and Chamath Palihapitiya.

Co-founder Venkat Viswanathan is now CEO. The leadership page listed Austin Sendek as CEO in its 5 December 2025 capture; by 9 March 2026 it lists Viswanathan as CEO and no longer lists Sendek. No announcement was found.
NVIDIA announced a planned strategic investment in Entalpic during its Paris visit. No amount was given; Tech.eu, citing Les Echos, calls it a minority stake.

Nobel laureate Susumu Kitagawa joined the advisory board. The same release says CuspAI "has raised over $725M", about $145M more than the rounds on record, with no announcement of the difference found. It also describes operations in Tokyo (a Japanese entity) and Singapore.
Masahiro Fujita became Country Manager, Japan, and his predecessor Tomoya Yamada became SVP, Global Operations.
An English release says the Series A is complete and total funding exceeds $100M. It gives no new amount and appears to restate the July close.
Announced Rima Alameddine (ex-IonQ CRO) as an independent non-executive director; Companies House dates the appointment 22 September 2026.
Preliminary unaudited FY2026 results (to 31 August): revenue about C$9.3M, up 60%, and a net loss of about C$4.6M.

Possibly shut down, unconfirmed. tetsuwan.com fails at the TLS handshake on 28 November (it was up on 12 October), though its Ashby board still lists two June roles. Search snippets point to a late-October LinkedIn post about closing, which was not opened.
